ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels vs 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white contiguous field across both lobes; low-intensity black perimeter band along the trailing edge and lateral tips; vertical black column at the peduncle junction; single high-contrast black circular blob located on the left lobe upper-mid quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 45 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 25 pixels in amplitude; highest frequency of serration occurs at the lateral-most 20% of each fluke lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitting the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white calcified barnacle formations localized on the leading and trailing edges of both distal tips; scattered dark focal pits on the white ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint horizontal grey linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular black lesion/hole on the upper left lobe; heavy barnacle colonization on distal margins; irregular tissue loss along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated high-contrast black circular spot located in the superior-medial region of the left lobe.
